# Skip binary files

Files containing a NUL byte within the first 8192 bytes are considered binary and are not collected as source_file artifacts.

Avoid staging binary blobs as text-based engineering-knowledge artifacts.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/git.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.git.GitCollector.collect_at_commit`
